title: STAR: tell a story interviewers remember
intro: Behavioural questions are really 'tell me a story'. Here is the shape that works.

predict.question: Which part of a STAR answer should get the MOST airtime?
predict.reveal: Action. Interviewers hire the person who did the work, so spend most of your time on what YOU did and why.

takeaway: Keep Situation and Task brief, spend your time on Action, and land a concrete Result.

steps.say: Question: 'Tell me about a time you fixed a hard bug.' Use STAR: Situation, Task, Action, Result.

cards.title: Situation
cards.text: Set the scene in one or two sentences.

cards.title: Task
cards.text: What was YOUR responsibility?

cards.title: Action
cards.text: What did YOU do, step by step?

cards.title: Result
cards.text: What changed? Use a number if you can.

steps.say: Action: the heart of the answer. Say what you did, in order: reproduced it, read the logs, found a race, added a lock.
